description: Implement a Google Cloud Storage provider that communicates directly with the GCS API instead of using the AWS S3 compatibility layer. This provider should integrate with the existing remote storage abstraction and support all necessary storage operations without adding new SDK dependencies beyond gcp_auth for authentication.
functional_requirements: Implement a GCS provider class that implements the same interface as existing storage providers (like S3)
Support all core storage operations: upload, download, list, delete, and metadata retrieval for timeline files
Integrate with the configuration system to allow users to specify GCS as their storage backend with appropriate credentials
Handle GCS-specific authentication using gcp_auth library with support for service account credentials and default application credentials
Include proper error handling and logging for GCS API responses and network failures
Add integration tests that verify the GCS provider works correctly with real or mocked GCS endpoints
